create_quantizer_torchao: create a TorchAoHfHfQuantizer instance with a TorchAoConfig to quantize a HuggingFace model using torchao
validate_torchao_environment: validate the environment supports torchao and check device_map compatibility for pre-quantized models
flatten_state_dict_safetensors: flatten the state dict of tensor subclasses so it is compatible with the safetensors format
quantize_linear_embeddings: quantize nn.Linear and nn.Embedding weight parameters while skipping modules in modules_to_not_convert
deserialize_pre_quantized_weights: deserialize pre-quantized torchao checkpoint weights using source patterns like _weight_qdata and _weight_scale
